dossier.purpose: Node.js CLI (npm package claude-code-templates, alias cct) plus a component catalog, website/API and local dashboards. The CLI downloads individual Claude Code components (agents, commands, MCP configs, settings, hooks, skills, loops, mods, project templates) from this repo's main branch into a project's .claude/ directory. The catalog (cli-tool/components/) aggregates first-party and many third-party components: 900 SKILL.md files on disk, 877 skills per the generated counts. It is not a single upstream skills collection; the README attribution lists more than ten upstream sources. A separate Rust cct preview (v0.1.0) ports the install path. Sources: README.md:61,146-167; CLAUDE.md:5-7; dashboard/public/counts.json:1; cli-rust/README.md:3-9.

claims.claim: Ready-to-use configurations for Anthropic's Claude Code: a collection of AI agents, custom commands, settings, hooks, external integrations (MCPs) and project templates.
Interactive web interface (aitmpl.com) to explore and install '100+ agents, commands, settings, hooks, and MCPs'.
Install components with npx claude-code-templates@latest --agent|--command|--setting|--hook|--mcp <category/name> --yes, or run it interactively.
Skills are 'Reusable capabilities with progressive disclosure' (examples: PDF processing, Excel automation, custom workflows).

Skills can be installed from the CLI. The sponsor block (Bright Data, sponsored placement) gives: npx claude-code-templates@latest --skill web-data/search,web-data/scrape,web-data/data-feeds,web-data/bright-data-mcp,web-data/bright-data-best-practices,development/brightdata-local-search --mcp web-data/brightdata --yes

Extra tools: --analytics dashboard, --chats (with --tunnel: 'Secure remote access via Cloudflare Tunnel'), --health-check, and --plugins dashboard ('view marketplaces, installed plugins, and manage permissions').
docs.aitmpl.com holds 'Complete guides, examples, and API reference for all components and tools' (external site, not in the repo).
Contributing guidelines cover adding 'agents, commands, MCPs, settings, or hooks' (skills are not named).

The collection includes components from many sources: K-Dense-AI/claude-scientific-skills (139 scientific skills), anthropics/skills (21), anthropics/claude-code (10), obra/superpowers (14), alirezarezvani/claude-skills (36), wshobson/agents (48), NerdyChefsAI, awesome-claude-code (21 commands), awesome-claude-skills, others.
'Each of these resources retains its original license and attribution'.
'This project is licensed under the MIT License'.
Not stated anywhere in the README: telemetry or data collection, network requirements, Codex support, Linux/macOS/WSL support, per-task skill selection, release verification.

Fire-and-forget POSTs to www.aitmpl.com with a 5 s timeout: /api/track-download-supabase after each successful install (type, name, path = relative target dir or component name, category, cliVersion; cli-tool/src/tracking-service.js:112-140; skill call at cli-tool/src/index.js:1661-1667), /api/track-installation-outcome (component type/name, success or failure, error type and message, duration, CLI and Node versions, platform, arch, batchId; tracking-service.js:296-346) and /api/track-command-usage for dashboard, health, stats and sandbox commands (tracking-service.js:223-270). Server side stores IP address, user-agent and country for downloads in Supabase (dashboard/src/pages/api/track-download-supabase.ts:45-67) and outcomes/command usage in Neon (track-installation-outcome.ts:55-75; track-command-usage.ts:57-77). Opt-out: CCT_NO_TRACKING=true, CCT_NO_ANALYTICS=true or CI=true (literal 'true' only; tracking-service.js:15-25); Rust cct also honours '1' (cli-rust/src/tracking.rs:12-18). Opt-out is documented only outside the README (.github/WORKFLOWS_REFERENCE.md:82-83; cli-rust/README.md:52-53; CLAUDE.md:390-396). Required network: api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com on every component install, with no offline mode and no ref pinning (index.js:1559-1613); no account or API key is needed for installs. Other network use: --health-check GETs api.anthropic.com (health-check.js:362-386); --sandbox and --studio need E2B/Anthropic keys (index.js:2954-2999); --tunnel needs a separately installed cloudflared (analytics.js:1344-1354); --clone-session downloads from an arbitrary URL (session-sharing.js:266-267); session-upload code for x0.at exists (session-sharing.js:209-257) but no call site was found in cli-tool/src. code.architecture: Node CommonJS CLI: cli-tool/bin/create-claude-config.js (commander) calls cli-tool/src/index.js (3,727-line dispatcher). Component installers fetch files live from davila7/claude-code-templates@main (cli-tool/components/{agents,commands,mcps,settings,hooks,skills,loops,mods,sandbox}) through raw.githubusercontent.com and the GitHub contents API. Skills are downloaded recursively, kept in a category/name tree in the repo, and written under <dir>/.claude/skills/<last path segment>/. Project templates use cli-tool/src/templates.js and file-operations.js (download cli-tool/templates/*/CLAUDE.md etc. with backup/merge prompts). Local dashboards (Express + ws): analytics.js with analytics/**, chats-mobile.js, plugin-dashboard.js, skill-dashboard.js (read-only skill viewer), teams-dashboard.js, sandbox-server.js. Telemetry: tracking-service.js and error-reporting.js. Validation: cli-tool/src/validation/* plus security-audit.js (CI and catalog generation only, not run at install). Catalog pipeline: scripts/generate_components_json.py to docs/components.json and dashboard/public/**. Website/API: dashboard/ (Astro 5 + React on Cloudflare Pages) and cloudflare-workers/* cron and report workers. Rust preview: cli-rust/ (clap, reqwest) mirrors the install path and delegates other flags to npx -y claude-code-templates@latest. Repo-local .claude/ agents and commands are maintainer tooling.

risks: Unpinned, unverified content: every component, skills included, is fetched at install time from this repo's main branch via the GitHub contents API or raw URLs. There is no tag or commit pin, checksum or signature check, and no flag or env var to choose a ref (cli-tool/src/index.js:1559-1626; cli-rust/src/constants.rs:7-21; flags at cli-tool/bin/create-claude-config.js:15-54). The npm tarball ships no skills (package.json:46-52), so installs need network and make unauthenticated GitHub API calls (no token support found; index.js:1568-1573; cli-rust/src/github.rs:81-84).

Claude Code only, project-scoped. Skills are written to <dir>/.claude/skills/<last path segment>/ (cli-tool/src/index.js:1556,1598,1637-1649; cli-rust/src/github.rs:113-115). No Codex or .agents install target, no user-level skill scope (only -d <dir>), no Codex mention in README or CLI source. Keying by last segment makes duplicate names collide and overwrite same-named files with no prompt or backup (webapp-testing in development/ and security/; skill-creator and writing-skills in development/ and productivity/; dispatching-parallel-agents in ai-research/ and development/).

Heterogeneous, weakly traced catalog: 900 SKILL.md from many authors with inconsistent provenance. Frontmatter shows source: community/personal/self, 29 files with author: zebbern (offensive-security and pentest skills), 20 with author: openai, vibeship-spawner-skills, google/skills; some (development/systematic-debugging, development/code-review-checklist) carry no author or licence; no upstream commit pin. Some skills are workflow bundles that name other skills (security/security-audit/SKILL.md:28-40) and --loop auto-installs every component a loop references (index.js:1683-1704). Skills ship 861 .py and 69 .sh files (many are benchmark artefacts under ai-research/loki-mode/benchmarks/results/) and the installer chmods all .py/.sh to 755 (index.js:1596,1646-1648).

Licensing mix: repo is MIT but vendors components under other terms, including Anthropic's proprietary all-rights-reserved LICENSE.txt on docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx skills that forbids copying, distribution and derivatives (cli-tool/components/skills/document-processing/docx/LICENSE.txt:13-24); ANTHROPIC_ATTRIBUTION.md:27-34 calls them not open source and lines 40-42 mention GPL-3.0 FFmpeg. Other skills are Apache-2.0, CC-BY-4.0 or MIT per file.

Telemetry is on by default (opt-out only) and absent from README.md. The server stores IP, user-agent and country (dashboard/src/pages/api/track-download-supabase.ts:45-67) while a repo doc calls it completely anonymous (.github/WORKFLOWS_REFERENCE.md:40). CCT_NO_TRACKING=1 does not disable the Node CLI, only 'true' (tracking-service.js:15-25). Error messages are uploaded with install outcomes (track-installation-outcome.ts:55-75).

Security posture: GHSA-79wm-x847-7cvg (unauthenticated RCE in --studio, CVSS 8.8) was fixed only in 1.29.4 (CHANGELOG.md:8-26). Other local servers still call listen(port) with no host, analytics sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin * and there is no auth (cli-tool/src/analytics.js:622,1274; skill-dashboard.js:468; chats-mobile.js:1049); --tunnel publishes them via cloudflared; --prompt spawns claude with shell: true (index.js:2746-2750). CI gaps: component audit is non-blocking and skips skills (security-audit.js:21; component-security-validation.yml:42-47); SkillSpector gate covers only changed skills and is installed from NVIDIA main unpinned (skill-security-scan.yml:35-48); weekly full scan never blocks (skill-security-scan-all.yml:3-5); no Actions pinned by SHA; CODEOWNERS excludes cli-tool/ (.github/CODEOWNERS:1-6).

Maintenance and doc consistency: version drift (root 1.29.6, cli-tool 1.29.4, CHANGELOG top entry 1.29.4); root npm test is a no-op (package.json:12) though CLAUDE.md:14,217 tell maintainers to run it; two Jest tests read nonexistent files (DataService.test.js:11, StateService.test.js:11) and Jest runs in CI only in the GitHub Packages publish workflow (publish-package.yml:50-52); stale docs (.github/WORKFLOWS_REFERENCE.md:5-21 names deploy-docusaurus.yml and Vercel, dated 2025-08-19 at line 87; docs/CLAUDE.md:30-33; CLAUDE.md:59 claims 600+ agents vs 422 in counts.json); README quick-install paths and cli-tool/README.md skill names do not resolve; Rust CLI is a v0.1.0 preview whose documented install.sh is missing; no release checksums, signatures or provenance.

Scope and ownership: one repo bundles the installer, five local dashboards, a Cloudflare Pages website and API with Supabase, Neon, Clerk, Discord, Telegram, Resend and Sentry backends, Workers, and a Rust port (CLAUDE.md:246-405); skill install is one function inside a 3,727-line index.js. The catalog site, download stats and docs.aitmpl.com are maintainer-hosted and were not read. The README leads with a sponsor's (Bright Data) install command (README.md:34-55). Maintenance is attributed to one named person (SECURITY.md:7; CODEOWNERS single owner).
